result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely obstructed by a large trailer parked across the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the roadway. The intersection lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trailer is parked entirely across the sidewalk, completely blocking pedestrian passage.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, occupying the sidewalk area

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The intersection has no painted crosswalks to guide pedestrians or alert drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The trailer blocks sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance Enforcement
interventions.description: Enforce parking regulations to remove the trailer and restore the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the corner to ensure clear sight lines for all users.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with row houses and sidewalks on both sides. While the narrow roadway width naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crossings and the presence of parked vehicles on the right create potential sightline obstructions for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars on the right side of the street block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked area for pedestrians to cross this residential street.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility and shorten crossing distances.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees would provide vertical enclosure to further calm traffic and improve the pedestrian environment.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is severely compromised by a vehicle parked directly on the sidewalk and the overall poor condition of the walkway. There is a complete lack of marked crossing infrastructure, and the absence of lane markings on the roadway further reduces safety for all users.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Parking
hazards.description: A black SUV is parked entirely on the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians into the street.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk surface is cracked, uneven, and transitions into dirt, creating trip hazards.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage are visible at this intersection area.

interventions.title: Bollard Installation
interventions.description: Install bollards along the curb line to prevent vehicles from parking on the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the sidewalk surface to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant path.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Paint a high-visibility continental crosswalk to designate a safe crossing point.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide, unmarked one-way roadway adjacent to a fenced recreational area. There is a complete lack of crossing infrastructure, such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, which forces pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Absence of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing points exist, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Calming
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway without lane markings may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicle
hazards.description: A parked car on the far side of the street can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds in this recreational zone.
